GenAiFunction.description: Drafts a professional message asking the borrower or branch for the documents still needed to complete an audit case: every required document that is not yet linked (required first, then optional), formatted as a request the auditor can send. Read only — it never sends anything, never creates or changes evidence records, and never decides the loan. The draft carries a polite deadline placeholder for the auditor to fill in, and a human auditor reviews and sends it.
